_description: Token usage baseline per document — established Week 11 (2026-03-20).
_methodology: Ran all 20 fixtures once against live Bedrock (Haiku). Recorded total_tokens per fixture. Baseline = observed average. Alert threshold = baseline * 1.20.
_update_instructions: This runs all 20 fixtures, computes avg total_tokens, and writes new values here.
Commit the updated baseline alongside any prompt changes.
Never auto-update the baseline in CI — only update manually after a deliberate prompt change.
